56. al-Waqi`ah: That Which is Coming

[056_001]1 When the event befalleth - 

[056_002]2 There is no denying that it will befall - 

[056_003]3 Abasing (some), exalting (others); 

[056_004]4 When the earth is shaken with a shock 

[056_005]5 And the hills are ground to powder 

[056_006]6 So that they become a scattered dust, 

[056_007]7 And ye will be three kinds: 

[056_008]8 (First) those on the right hand; what of those on the right hand ? 

[056_009]9 And (then) those on the left hand; what of those on the left hand ? 

[056_010]10 And the foremost in the race, the foremost in the race: 

[056_011]11 Those are they who will be brought nigh 

[056_012]12 In gardens of delight; 

[056_013]13 A multitude of those of old 

[056_014]14 And a few of those of later time. 

[056_015]15 On lined couches, 

[056_016]16 Reclining therein face to face. 

[056_017]17 There wait on them immortal youths 

[056_018]18 With bowls and ewers and a cup from a pure spring 

[056_019]19 Wherefrom they get no aching of the head nor any madness, 

[056_020]20 And fruit that they prefer 

[056_021]21 And flesh of fowls that they desire. 

[056_022]22 And (there are) fair ones with wide, lovely eyes, 

[056_023]23 Like unto hidden pearls, 

[056_024]24 Reward for what they used to do. 

[056_025]25 There hear they no vain speaking nor recrimination 

[056_026]26 (Naught) but the saying: Peace, (and again) Peace. 

[056_027]27 And those on the right hand; what of those on the right hand ? 

[056_028]28 Among thornless lote-trees 

[056_029]29 And clustered plantains, 

[056_030]30 And spreading shade, 

[056_031]31 And water gushing, 

[056_032]32 And fruit in plenty 

[056_033]33 Neither out of reach nor yet forbidden, 

[056_034]34 And raised couches; 

[056_035]35 Lo! We have created them a (new) creation 

[056_036]36 And made them virgins, 

[056_037]37 Lovers, friends, 

[056_038]38 For those on the right hand; 

[056_039]39 A multitude of those of old 

[056_040]40 And a multitude of those of later time. 

[056_041]41 And those on the left hand: What of those on the left hand ? 

[056_042]42 In scorching wind and scalding water 

[056_043]43 And shadow of black smoke, 

[056_044]44 Neither cool nor refreshing. 

[056_045]45 Lo! heretofore they were effete with luxury 

[056_046]46 And used to persist in the awful sin. 

[056_047]47 And they used to say: When we are dead and have become dust and bones,  shall we then, forsooth, be raised again, 

[056_048]48 And also our forefathers ? 

[056_049]49 Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Lo! those of old and those of later time 

[056_050]50 Will all be brought together to the tryst of an appointed day. 

[056_051]51 Then lo! ye, the erring, the deniers, 

[056_052]52 Ye verily will eat of a tree called Zaqqum 

[056_053]53 And will fill your bellies therewith; 

[056_054]54 And thereon ye will drink of boiling water, 

[056_055]55 Drinking even as the camel drinketh. 

[056_056]56 This will be their welcome on the Day of Judgment. 

[056_057]57 We created you. Will ye then admit the truth ? 

[056_058]58 Have ye seen that which ye emit ? 

[056_059]59 Do ye create it or are We the Creator ? 

[056_060]60 We mete out death among you, and We are not to be outrun, 

[056_061]61 That We may transfigure you and make you what ye know not. 

[056_062]62 And verily ye know the first creation. Why, then, do ye not reflect ? 

[056_063]63 Have ye seen that which ye cultivate ? 

[056_064]64 Is it ye who foster it, or are We the Fosterer ? 

[056_065]65 If We willed, We verily could make it chaff, then would ye cease not to  exclaim: 

[056_066]66 Lo! we are laden with debt! 

[056_067]67 Nay, but we are deprived! 

[056_068]68 Have ye observed the water which ye drink ? 

[056_069]69 Is it ye who shed it from the raincloud, or are We the Shedder ? 

[056_070]70 If We willed We verily could make it bitter. Why then, give ye not thanks ? 

[056_071]71 Have ye observed the fire which ye strike out; 

[056_072]72 Was it ye who made the tree thereof to grow, or were We the grower ? 

[056_073]73 We, even We, appointed it a memorial and a comfort for the dwellers in the  wilderness. 

[056_074]74 Therefor (O Muhammad), praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous. 

[056_075]75 Nay, I swear by the places of the stars - 

[056_076]76 And lo! that verily is a tremendous oath, if ye but knew - 

[056_077]77 That (this) is indeed a noble Qur'an 

[056_078]78 In a Book kept hidden 

[056_079]79 Which none toucheth save the purified, 

[056_080]80 A revelation from the Lord of the Worlds. 

[056_081]81 Is it this Statement that ye scorn, 

[056_082]82 And make denial thereof your livelihood ? 

[056_083]83 Why, then, when (the soul) cometh up to the throat (of the dying) 

[056_084]84 And ye are at that moment looking 

[056_085]85 - And We are nearer unto him than ye are, but ye see not - 

[056_086]86 Why then, if ye are not in bondage (unto Us), 

[056_087]87 Do ye not force it back, if ye are truthful ? 

[056_088]88 Thus if he is of those brought nigh, 

[056_089]89 Then breath of life, and plenty, and a Garden of delight. 

[056_090]90 And if he is of those on the right hand, 

[056_091]91 Then (the greeting) "Peace be unto thee" from those on the right hand. 

[056_092]92 But if he is of the rejecters, the erring, 

[056_093]93 Then the welcome will be boiling water 

[056_094]94 And roasting at hell-fire. 

[056_095]95 Lo! this is certain truth. 

[056_096]96 Therefor (O Muhammad) praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous.

The Meaning of the Glorious Qur'an, by M.M. Pickthall, at sacred-texts.com

57. al-Hadid: The Iron

[057_001]1 All that is in the heavens and the earth glorifieth Allah; and He is the Mighty,  the Wise. 

[057_002]2 His is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; He quickeneth and He  giveth death; and He is Able to do all things. 

[057_003]3 He is the First and the Last, and the Outward and the Inward; and He is  Knower of all things. 

[057_004]4 He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days; then He mounted  the Throne. He knoweth all that entereth the earth and all that emergeth therefrom and  all that cometh down from the sky and all that ascendeth therein; and He is with you  wheresoever ye may be. And Allah is Seer of what ye do. 

[057_005]5 His is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, and unto Allah (all)  things are brought back. 

[057_006]6 He causeth the night to pass into the day, and He causeth the day to pass into  the night, and He is knower of all that is in the breasts. 

[057_007]7 Believe in Allah and His messenger, and spend of that whereof He hath  made you trustees; and such of you as believe and spend (aright), theirs will be a great  reward. 

[057_008]8 What aileth you that ye believe not in Allah, when the messenger calleth you  to believe in your Lord, and He hath already made a covenant with you, if ye are  believers ? 

[057_009]9 He it is Who sendeth down clear revelations unto His slave, that He may  bring you forth from darkness unto light; and lo! for you, Allah is Full of Pity,  Merciful. 

[057_010]10 And what aileth you that ye spend not in the way of Allah when unto Allah  belongeth the inheritance of the heavens and the earth ? Those who spent and fought  before the victory are not upon a level (with the rest of you). Such are greater in rank  than those who spent and fought afterwards. Unto each hath Allah promised good.  And Allah is Informed of what ye do. 

[057_011]11 Who is he that will lend unto Allah a goodly loan, that He may double it for  him and his may be a rich reward ? 

[057_012]12 On the day when thou (Muhammad) wilt see the believers, men and women,  their light shining forth before them and on their right hands, (and wilt hear it said  unto them): Glad news for you this day: Gardens underneath which rivers flow,  wherein ye are immortal. That is the supreme triumph. 

[057_013]13 On the day when the hypocritical men and the hypocritical women will say  unto those who believe: Look on us that we may borrow from your light! it will be  said: Go back and seek for light! Then there will separate them a wall wherein is a  gate, the inner side whereof containeth mercy, while the outer side thereof is toward  the doom. 

[057_014]14 They will cry unto them (saying): Were we not with you ? They will say:  Yea, verily; but ye tempted one another, and hesitated, and doubted, and vain desires  beguiled you till the ordinance of Allah came to pass; and the deceiver deceived you  concerning Allah; 

[057_015]15 So this day no ransom can be taken from you nor from those who  disbelieved. Your home is the Fire; that is your patron, and a hapless journey's end. 

[057_016]16 Is not the time ripe for the hearts of those who believe to submit to Allah's  reminder and to the truth which is revealed, that they become not as those who  received the scripture of old but the term was prolonged for them and so their hearts  were hardened, and many of them are evil-livers. 

[057_017]17 Know that Allah quickeneth the earth after its death. We have made clear  Our revelations for you, that haply ye may understand. 

[057_018]18 Lo! those who give alms, both men and women, and lend unto Allah a  goodly loan, it will be doubled for them, and theirs will be a rich reward. 

[057_019]19 And those who believe in Allah and His messengers, they are the loyal, and  the martyrs are with their Lord; they have their reward and their light; while as for  those who disbelieve and deny Our revelations, they are owners of hell-fire. 

[057_020]20 Know that the life of the world is only play, and idle talk, and pageantry, and  boasting among you, and rivalry in respect of wealth and children; as the likeness of  vegetation after rain, whereof the growth is pleasing to the husbandman, but afterward  it drieth up and thou seest it turning yellow, then it becometh straw. And in the  Hereafter there is grievous punishment, and (also) forgiveness from Allah and His  good pleasure, whereas the life of the world is but matter of illusion. 

[057_021]21 Race one with another for forgiveness from your Lord and a Garden whereof  the breadth is as the breadth of the heavens and the earth, which is in store for those  who believe in Allah and His messengers. Such is the bounty of Allah, which He  bestoweth upon whom He will, and Allah is of Infinite Bounty. 

[057_022]22 Naught of disaster befalleth in the earth or in yourselves but it is in a Book  before we bring it into being - Lo! that is easy for Allah - 

[057_023]23 That ye grieve not for the sake of that which hath escaped you, nor yet exult  because of that which hath been given. Allah loveth not all prideful boasters, 

[057_024]24 Who hoard and who enjoin upon the people avarice. And whosoever turneth  away, still Allah is the Absolute, the Owner of Praise. 

[057_025]25 We verily sent Our messengers with clear proofs, and revealed with them the  Scripture and the Balance, that mankind may observe right measure; and He revealed  iron, wherein is mighty power and (many) uses for mankind, and that Allah may  know him who helpeth Him and His messengers, though unseen. Lo! Allah is Strong,  Almighty. 

[057_026]26 And We verily sent Noah and Abraham and placed the prophethood and the  scripture among their seed, and among them there is he who goeth right, but many of  them are evil-livers. 

[057_027]27 Then We caused Our messengers to follow in their footsteps; and We caused  Jesus, son of Mary, to follow, and gave him the Gospel, and placed compassion and  mercy in the hearts of those who followed him. But monasticism they invented - We  ordained it not for them - only seeking Allah's pleasure, and they observed it not with  right observance. So We give those of them who believe their reward, but many of  them are evil-livers. 

[057_028]28 O ye who believe! Be mindful of your duty to Allah and put faith in His  messenger. He will give you twofold of His mercy and will appoint for you a light  wherein ye shall walk, and will forgive you. Allah is Forgiving, Merciful; 

[057_029]29 That the People of the Scripture may know that they control naught of the  bounty of Allah, but that the bounty is in Allah's hand to give to whom He will. And  Allah is of Infinite Bounty.

The Meaning of the Glorious Qur'an, by M.M. Pickthall, at sacred-texts.com

58. al-Mujadilah: She Who Pleaded

[058_001]1 Allah hath heard the saying of her that disputeth with thee (Muhammad)  concerning her husband, and complaineth unto Allah. And Allah heareth your  colloquy. Lo! Allah is Hearer, Knower. 

[058_002]2 Such of you as put away your wives (by saying they are as their mothers) -  They are not their mothers; none are their mothers except those who gave them birth -  they indeed utter an ill word and a lie. And lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful. 

[058_003]3 Those who put away their wives (by saying they are as their mothers) and  afterward would go back on that which they have said, (the penalty) in that case (is)  the freeing of a slave before they touch one another. Unto this ye are exhorted; and  Allah is Informed of what ye do. 

[058_004]4 And he who findeth not (the wherewithal), let him fast for two successive  months before they touch one another; and for him who is unable to do so (the  penance is) the feeding of sixty needy ones. This, that ye may put trust in Allah and  His messenger. Such are the limits (imposed by Allah); and for disbelievers is a  painful doom. 

[058_005]5 Lo! those who oppose Allah and His messenger will be abased even as those  before them were abased; and We have sent down clear tokens, and for disbelievers is  a shameful doom 

[058_006]6 On the day when Allah will raise them all together and inform them of what  they did. Allah hath kept account of it while they forgot it. And Allah is Witness over  all things. 

[058_007]7 Hast thou not seen that Allah knoweth all that is in the heavens and all that is  in the earth ? There is no secret conference of three but He is their fourth, nor of five  but He is their sixth, nor of less than that or more but He is with them wheresoever  they may be; and afterward, on the Day of Resurrection, He will inform them of what  they did. Lo! Allah is Knower of all things. 

[058_008]8 Hast thou not observed those who were forbidden conspiracy and afterward  returned to that which they had been forbidden, and (now) conspire together for crime  and wrongdoing and disobedience toward the messenger ? And when they come unto  thee they greet thee with a greeting wherewith Allah greeteth thee not, and say within  themselves: Why should Allah punish us for what we say ? Hell will suffice them;  they will feel the heat thereof - a hapless journey's end! 

[058_009]9 O ye who believe! When ye conspire together, conspire not together for  crime and wrongdoing and disobedience toward the messenger, but conspire together  for righteousness and piety, and keep your duty toward Allah, unto whom ye will be  gathered. 

[058_010]10 Lo! Conspiracy is only of the devil, that he may vex those who believe; but  he can harm them not at all unless by Allah's leave. In Allah let believers put their  trust. 

[058_011]11 O ye who believe! when it is said unto you, Make room! in assemblies, then  make room; Allah will make way for you (hereafter). And when it is said, Come up  higher! go up higher; Allah will exalt those who believe among you, and those who  have knowledge, to high ranks. Allah is Informed of what ye do. 

[058_012]12 O ye who believe! When ye hold conference with the messenger, offer an  alms before your conference. That is better and purer for you. But if ye cannot find  (the wherewithal) then lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful. 

[058_013]13 Fear ye to offer alms before your conference ? Then, when ye do it not and  Allah hath forgiven you, establish worship and pay the poor-due and obey Allah and  His messenger. And Allah is Aware of what ye do. 

[058_014]14 Hast thou not seen those who take for friends a folk with whom Allah is  wroth ? They are neither of you nor of them, and they swear a false oath knowingly. 

[058_015]15 Allah hath prepared for them a dreadful doom. Evil indeed is that which they  are wont to do. 

[058_016]16 They make a shelter of their oaths and turn (men) from the way of Allah; so  theirs will be a shameful doom. 

[058_017]17 Their wealth and their children will avail them naught against Allah. Such  are rightful owners of the Fire; they will abide therein. 

[058_018]18 On the day when Allah will raise them all together, then will they swear unto  Him as they (now) swear unto you, and they will fancy that they have some standing.  Lo! is it not they who are the liars ? 

[058_019]19 The devil hath engrossed them and so hath caused them to forget  remembrance of Allah. They are the devil's party. Lo! is it not the devil's party who  will be the losers ? 

[058_020]20 Lo! those who oppose Allah and His messenger, they will be among the  lowest. 

[058_021]21 Allah hath decreed: Lo! I verily shall conquer, I and My messengers. Lo!  Allah is Strong, Almighty. 

[058_022]22 Thou wilt not find folk who believe in Allah and the Last Day loving those  who oppose Allah and His messenger, even though they be their fathers or their sons  or their brethren or their clan. As for such, He hath written faith upon their hearts and  hath strengthened them with a Spirit from Him, and He will bring them into Gardens  underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide. Allah is well pleased with  them, and they are well pleased with Him. They are Allah's party. Lo! is it not Allah's  party who are the successful ?

The Meaning of the Glorious Qur'an, by M.M. Pickthall, at sacred-texts.com

59. al-Hashr: The Exile

[059_001]1 All that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth glorifieth Allah, and He is  the Mighty, the Wise. 

[059_002]2 He it is Who hath caused those of the People of the Scripture who  disbelieved to go forth from their homes unto the first exile. Ye deemed not that they  would go forth, while they deemed that their strongholds would protect them from  Allah.  But Allah reached them from a place whereof they recked not, and cast terror  in their hearts so that they ruined their houses with their own hands and the hands of  the believers. So learn a lesson, O ye who have eyes! 

[059_003]3 And if Allah had not decreed migration for them, He verily would have  punished them in the world, and theirs in the Hereafter is the punishment of the Fire. 

[059_004]4 That is because they were opposed to Allah and His messenger; and whoso is  opposed to Allah, (for him) verily Allah is stern in reprisal. 

[059_005]5 Whatsoever palm-trees ye cut down or left standing on their roots, it was by  Allah's leave, in order that He might confound the evil-livers. 

[059_006]6 And that which Allah gave as spoil unto His messenger from them, ye urged  not any horse or riding-camel for the sake thereof, but Allah giveth His messenger  lordship over whom He will. Allah is Able to do all things. 

[059_007]7 That which Allah giveth as spoil unto His messenger from the people of the  townships, it is for Allah and His messenger and for the near of kin and the orphans  and the needy and the wayfarer, that it become not a commodity between the rich  among you. And whatsoever the messenger giveth you, take it. And whatsoever he  forbiddeth, abstain (from it). And keep your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is stern in  reprisal. 

[059_008]8 And (it is) for the poor fugitives who have been driven out from their homes  and their belongings, who seek bounty from Allah and help Allah and His messenger.  They are the loyal. 

[059_009]9 Those who entered the city and the faith before them love those who flee  unto them for refuge, and find in their breasts no need for that which hath been given  them, but prefer (the fugitives) above themselves though poverty become their lot.  And whoso is saved from his own avarice - such are they who are successful. 

[059_010]10 And those who came (into the faith) after them say: Our Lord! Forgive us  and our brethren who were before us in the faith, and place not in our hearts any  rancour toward those who believe. Our Lord! Thou art Full of Pity, Merciful. 

[059_011]11 Hast thou not observed those who are hypocrites, (how) they tell their  brethren who disbelieve among the People of the Scripture: If ye are driven out, we  surely will go out with you, and we will never obey anyone against you, and if ye are  attacked we verily will help you. And Allah beareth witness that they verily are liars. 

[059_012]12 (For) indeed if they are driven out they go not out with them, and indeed if  they are attacked they help them not, and indeed if they had helped them they would  have turned and fled, and then they would not have been victorious. 

[059_013]13 Ye are more awful as a fear in their bosoms than Allah. That is because they  are a folk who understand not. 

[059_014]14 They will not fight against you in a body save in fortified villages or from  behind walls. Their adversity among themselves is very great. Ye think of them as a  whole whereas their hearts are divers. That is because they are a folk who have no  sense. 

[059_015]15 On the likeness of those (who suffered) a short time before them, they taste  the ill-effects of their own conduct, and theirs is painful punishment. 

[059_016]16 (And the hypocrites are) on the likeness of the devil when he telleth man to  disbelieve, then, when he disbelieveth saith: Lo! I am quit of thee. Lo! I fear Allah,  the Lord of the Worlds. 

[059_017]17 And the consequence for both will be that they are in the Fire, therein  abiding. Such is the reward of evil-doers. 

[059_018]18 O ye who believe! Observe your duty to Allah. And let every soul look to  that which it sendeth on before for the morrow. And observe your duty to Allah. Lo!  Allah is Informed of what ye do. 

[059_019]19 And be not ye as those who forgot Allah, therefor He caused them to forget  their souls. Such are the evil-doers. 

[059_020]20 Not equal are the owners of the Fire and the owners of the Garden. The  owners of the Garden, they are the victorious. 

[059_021]21 If We had caused this Qur'an to descend upon a mountain, thou (O  Muhammad) verily hadst seen it humbled, rent asunder by the fear of Allah. Such  similitudes coin We for mankind that haply they may reflect. 

[059_022]22 He is Allah, than Whom there is no other God, the Knower of the Invisible  and the Visible. He is the Beneficent, Merciful. 

[059_023]23 He is Allah, than Whom there is no other God, the Sovereign Lord, the Holy  One, Peace, the Keeper of Faith, the Guardian, the Majestic, the Compeller, the  Superb. Glorified be Allah from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him). 

[059_024]24 He is Allah, the Creator, the Shaper out of naught, the Fashioner. His are the  most beautiful names. All that is in the heavens and the earth glorifieth Him, and He  is the Mighty, the Wise.

The Meaning of the Glorious Qur'an, by M.M. Pickthall, at sacred-texts.com

60. al-Mumtahanah: She Who is Tested

[060_001]1 O ye who believe! Choose not My enemy and your enemy for allies. Do ye  give them friendship when they disbelieve in that truth which hath come unto you,  driving out the messenger and you because ye believe in Allah, your Lord ? If ye have  come forth to strive in My way and seeking My good pleasure, (show them not  friendship). Do ye show friendship unto them in secret, when I am Best Aware of  what ye hide and what ye proclaim ? And whosoever doeth it among you, he verily  hath strayed from the right way. 

[060_002]2 If they have the upper hand of you, they will be your foes, and will stretch  out their hands and their tongues toward you with evil (intent), and they long for you  to disbelieve. 

[060_003]3 Your ties of kindred and your children will avail you naught upon the Day of  Resurrection. He will part you. Allah is Seer of what ye do. 

[060_004]4 There is a goodly pattern for you in Abraham and those with him, when they  told their folk: Lo! we are guiltless of you and all that ye worship beside Allah. We  have done with you. And there hath arisen between us and you hostility and hate for  ever until ye believe in Allah only - save that which Abraham promised his father  (when he said): I will ask forgiveness for thee, though I own nothing for thee from  Allah - Our Lord! In Thee we put our trust, and unto Thee we turn repentant, and unto  Thee is the journeying. 

[060_005]5 Our Lord! Make us not a prey for those who disbelieve, and forgive us, our  Lord! Lo! Thou, only Thou, are the Mighty, the Wise. 

[060_006]6 Verily ye have in them a goodly pattern for everyone who looketh to Allah  and the Last Day. And whosoever may turn away, lo! still Allah, He is the Absolute,  the Owner of Praise. 

[060_007]7 It may be that Allah will ordain love between you and those of them with  whom ye are at enmity. Allah is Mighty, and Allah is Forgiving, Merciful. 

[060_008]8 Allah forbiddeth you not those who warred not against you on account of  religion and drove you not out from your homes, that ye should show them kindness  and deal justly with them. Lo! Allah loveth the just dealers. 

[060_009]9 Allah forbiddeth you only those who warred against you on account of  religion and have driven you out from your homes and helped to drive you out, that  ye make friends of them. Whosoever maketh friends of them - (All) such are wrong- doers. 

[060_010]10 O ye who believe! When believing women come unto you as fugitives,  examine them. Allah is Best Aware of their faith. Then, if ye know them for true  believers, send them not back unto the disbelievers. They are not lawful for them (the  disbelievers), nor are they (the disbelievers) lawful for them. And give them (the  disbelievers) that which they have spent (upon them). And it is no sin for you to  marry such women when ye have given them their dues. And hold not to the ties of  disbelieving women; and ask for (the return of) that which ye have spent; and let them  (the disbelievers) ask for that which they have spent. That is the judgment of Allah.  He judgeth between you. Allah is Knower, Wise. 

[060_011]11 And if any of your wives have gone from you unto the disbelievers and  afterward ye have your turn (of triumph), then give unto those whose wives have  gone the like of that which they have spent, and keep your duty to Allah in Whom ye  are believers. 

[060_012]12 O Prophet! If believing women come unto thee, taking oath of allegiance  unto thee that they will ascribe no thing as partner unto Allah, and will neither steal  nor commit adultery nor kill their children, nor produce any lie that they have devised  between their hands and feet, nor disobey thee in what is right, then accept their  allegiance and ask Allah to forgive them. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful. 

[060_013]13 O ye who believe! Be not friendly with a folk with whom Allah is wroth, (a  folk) who have despaired of the Hereafter as the disbelievers despair of those who are  in the graves.

The Meaning of the Glorious Qur'an, by M.M. Pickthall, at sacred-texts.com

61. as-Saff: The Ranks

[061_001]1 All that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth glorifieth Allah, and He is  the Mighty, the Wise. 

[061_002]2 O ye who believe! Why say ye that which ye do not ? 

[061_003]3 It is most hateful in the sight of Allah that ye say that which ye do not. 

[061_004]4 Lo! Allah loveth them who battle for His cause in ranks, as if they were a  solid structure. 

[061_005]5 And (remember) when Moses said unto his people: O my people! Why  persecute ye me, when ye well know that I am Allah's messenger unto you ? So when  they went astray Allah sent their hearts astray. And Allah guideth not the evil-living  folk. 

[061_006]6 And when Jesus son of Mary said: O Children of Israel! Lo! I am the  messenger of Allah unto you, confirming that which was (revealed) before me in the  Torah, and bringing good tidings of a messenger who cometh after me, whose name  is the Praised One. Yet when he hath come unto them with clear proofs, they say:  This is mere magic. 

[061_007]7 And who doeth greater wrong than he who inventeth a lie against Allah when  he is summoned unto Al-Islam ? And Allah guideth not wrongdoing folk. 

[061_008]8 Fain would they put out the light of Allah with their mouths, but Allah will  perfect His light however much the disbelievers are averse. 

[061_009]9 He it is Who hath sent His messenger with the guidance and the religion of  truth, that He may make it conqueror of all religion however much idolaters may be  averse. 

[061_010]10 O ye who believe! Shall I show you a commerce that will save you from a  painful doom ? 

[061_011]11 Ye should believe in Allah and His messenger, and should strive for the  cause of Allah with your wealth and your lives. That is better for you, if ye did but  know. 

[061_012]12 He will forgive you your sins and bring you into Gardens underneath which  rivers flow, and pleasant dwellings in Gardens of Eden. That is the supreme triumph. 

[061_013]13 And (He will give you) another (blessing) which ye love: help from Allah  and present victory. Give good tidings (O Muhammad) to believers. 

[061_014]14 O ye who believe! Be Allah's helpers, even as Jesus son of Mary said unto  the disciples: Who are my helpers for Allah ? They said: We are Allah's helpers. And  a party of the Children of Israel believed, while a party disbelieved. Then We  strengthened those who believed against their foe, and they became the uppermost.

The Meaning of the Glorious Qur'an, by M.M. Pickthall, at sacred-texts.com

62. al-Jumu`ah: The Day of Congregation

[062_001]1 All that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth glorifieth Allah, the  Sovereign Lord, the Holy One, the Mighty, the Wise. 

[062_002]2 He it is Who hath sent among the unlettered ones a messenger of their own,  to recite unto them His revelations and to make them grow, and to teach them the  Scripture and wisdom, though heretofore they were indeed in error manifest, 

[062_003]3 Along with others of them who have not yet joined them. He is the Mighty,  the Wise. 

[062_004]4 That is the bounty of Allah; which He giveth unto whom He will. Allah is of  Infinite Bounty. 

[062_005]5 The likeness of those who are entrusted with the Law of Moses, yet apply it  not, is as the likeness of the ass carrying books. Wretched is the likeness of folk who  deny the revelations of Allah. And Allah guideth not wrongdoing folk. 

[062_006]6 Say (O Muhammad): O ye who are Jews! If ye claim that ye are favoured of  Allah apart from (all) mankind, then long for death if ye are truthful. 

[062_007]7 But they will never long for it because of all that their own hands have sent  before, and Allah is Aware of evil-doers. 

[062_008]8 Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Lo! the death from which ye shrink will  surely meet you, and afterward ye will be returned unto the Knower of the Invisible  and the Visible, and He will tell you what ye used to do. 

[062_009]9 O ye who believe! When the call is heard for the prayer of the day of  congregation, haste unto remembrance of Allah and leave your trading. That is better  for you if ye did but know. 

[062_010]10 And when the prayer is ended, then disperse in the land and seek of Allah's  bounty, and remember Allah much, that ye may be successful. 

[062_011]11 But when they spy some merchandise or pastime they break away to it and  leave thee standing. Say: That which Allah hath is better than pastime and than  merchandise, and Allah is the Best of providers.

The Meaning of the Glorious Qur'an, by M.M. Pickthall, at sacred-texts.com

63. al-Munafiqun: The Hypocrites

[063_001]1 When the hypocrites come unto thee (O Muhammad), they say: We bear  witness that thou art indeed Allah's messenger. And Allah knoweth that thou art  indeed His messenger, and Allah beareth witness that the hypocrites indeed are  speaking falsely. 

[063_002]2 They make their faith a pretext so that they may turn (men) from the way of  Allah. Verily evil is that which they are wont to do, 

[063_003]3 That is because they believed, then disbelieved, therefore their hearts are  sealed so that they understand not. 

[063_004]4 And when thou seest them their figures please thee; and if they speak thou  givest ear unto their speech. (They are) as though they were blocks of wood in striped  cloaks. They deem every shout to be against them. They are the enemy, so beware of  them. Allah confound them! How they are perverted! 

[063_005]5 And when it is said unto them: Come! The messenger of Allah will ask  forgiveness for you! they avert their faces and thou seest them turning away,  disdainful. 

[063_006]6 Whether thou ask forgiveness for them or ask not forgiveness for them is all  one for them; Allah will not forgive them. Lo! Allah guideth not the evil-living folk. 

[063_007]7 They it is who say: Spend not on behalf of those (who dwell) with Allah's  messenger that they may disperse (and go away from you); when Allah's are the  treasures of the heavens and the earth; but the hypocrites comprehend not. 

[063_008]8 They say: Surely, if we return to Al-Madinah the mightier will soon drive out  the weaker; when might belongeth to Allah and to His messenger and to the believers;  but the hypocrites know not. 

[063_009]9 O ye who believe! Let not your wealth nor your children distract you from  remembrance of Allah. Those who do so, they are the losers. 

[063_010]10 And spend of that wherewith We have provided you before death cometh  unto one of you and he saith: My Lord! If only thou wouldst reprieve me for a little  while, then I would give alms and be among the righteous. 

[063_011]11 But Allah reprieveth no soul when its term cometh, and Allah is Informed of  what ye do.

The Meaning of the Glorious Qur'an, by M.M. Pickthall, at sacred-texts.com

64. at-Taghabun: The Cheating

[064_001]1 All that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth glorifieth Allah; unto  Him belongeth Sovereignty and unto Him belongeth praise, and He is Able to do all  things. 

[064_002]2 He it is Who created you, but one of you is a disbeliever and one of you is a  believer, and Allah is Seer of what ye do. 

[064_003]3 He created the heavens and the earth with truth, and He shaped you and  made good your shapes, and unto Him is the journeying. 

[064_004]4 He knoweth all that is in the heavens and the earth, and He knoweth what ye  conceal and what ye publish. And Allah is Aware of what is in the breasts (of men). 

[064_005]5 Hath not the story reached you of those who disbelieved of old and so did  taste the ill-effects of their conduct, and theirs will be a painful doom. 

[064_006]6 That was because their messengers (from Allah) kept coming unto them with  clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty), but they said: Shall mere mortals guide us ? So  they disbelieved and turned away, and Allah was independent (of them). Allah is  Absolute, Owner of Praise. 

[064_007]7 Those who disbelieve assert that they will not be raised again. Say (unto  them, O Muhammad): Yea, verily, by my Lord! ye will be raised again and then ye  will be informed of what ye did; and that is easy for Allah. 

[064_008]8 So believe in Allah and His messenger and the light which We have  revealed. And Allah is Informed of what ye do. 

[064_009]9 The day when He shall gather you unto the Day of Assembling, that will be a  day of mutual disillusion. And whoso believeth in Allah and doeth right, He will  remit from him his evil deeds and will bring him unto Gardens underneath which  rivers flow, therein to abide for ever. That is the supreme triumph. 

[064_010]10 But those who disbelieve and deny Our revelations, such are owners of the  Fire; they will abide therein - a hapless journey's end! 

[064_011]11 No calamity befalleth save by Allah's leave. And whosoever believeth in  Allah, He guideth his heart. And Allah is Knower of all things. 

[064_012]12 Obey Allah and obey His messenger; but if ye turn away, then the duty of  Our messenger is only to convey (the message) plainly. 

[064_013]13 Allah! There is no God save Him. In Allah, therefore, let believers put their  trust. 

[064_014]14 O ye who believe! Lo! among your wives and your children there are  enemies for you, therefor beware of them. And if ye efface and overlook and forgive,  then lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful. 

[064_015]15 Your wealth and your children are only a temptation, whereas Allah! with  Him is an immense reward. 

[064_016]16 So keep your duty to Allah as best ye can, and listen, and obey, and spend;  that is better for your souls. And whoso is saved from his own greed, such are the  successful. 

[064_017]17 If ye lend unto Allah a goodly loan, He will double it for you and will  forgive you, for Allah is Responsive, Clement, 

[064_018]18 Knower of the Invisible and the Visible, the Mighty, the Wise.

The Meaning of the Glorious Qur'an, by M.M. Pickthall, at sacred-texts.com

65. at-Talaq: The Divorce

[065_001]1 O Prophet! When ye (men) put away women, put them away for their (legal)  period and reckon the period, and keep your duty to Allah, your Lord. Expel them not  from their houses nor let them go forth unless they commit open immorality. Such are  the limits (imposed by) Allah; and whoso transgresseth Allah's limits, he verily  wrongeth his soul. Thou knowest not: it may be that Allah will afterward bring some  new thing to pass. 

[065_002]2 Then, when they have reached their term, take them back in kindness or part  from them in kindness, and call to witness two just men among you, and keep your  testimony upright for Allah. Whoso believeth in Allah and the Last Day is exhorted to  act thus. And whosoever keepeth his duty to Allah, Allah will appoint a way out for  him, 

[065_003]3 And will provide for him from (a quarter) whence he hath no expectation.  And whosoever putteth his trust in Allah, He will suffice him. Lo! Allah bringeth His  command to pass. Allah hath set a measure for all things. 

[065_004]4 And for such of your women as despair of menstruation, if ye doubt, their  period (of waiting) shall be three months, along with those who have it not. And for  those with child, their period shall be till they bring forth their burden. And  whosoever keepeth his duty to Allah, He maketh his course easy for him. 

[065_005]5 That is the commandment of Allah which He revealeth unto you. And whoso  keepeth his duty to Allah, He will remit from him his evil deeds and magnify reward  for him. 

[065_006]6 Lodge them where ye dwell, according to your wealth, and harass them not  so as to straiten life for them. And if they are with child, then spend for them till they  bring forth their burden. Then, if they give suck for you, give them their due payment  and consult together in kindness; but if ye make difficulties for one another, then let  some other woman give suck for him (the father of the child). 

[065_007]7 Let him who hath abundance spend of his abundance, and he whose  provision is measured, let him spend of that which Allah hath given him. Allah asketh  naught of any soul save that which He hath given it. Allah will vouchsafe, after  hardship, ease. 

[065_008]8 And how many a community revolted against the ordinance of its Lord and  His messengers, and We called it to a stern account and punished it with dire  punishment, 

[065_009]9 So that it tasted the ill-effects of its conduct, and the consequence of its  conduct was loss. 

[065_010]10 Allah hath prepared for them stern punishment; so keep your duty to Allah,  O men of understanding! O ye who believe! Now Allah hath sent down unto you a  reminder, 

[065_011]11 A messenger reciting unto you the revelations of Allah made plain, that He  may bring forth those who believe and do good works from darkness unto light. And  whosoever believeth in Allah and doeth right, He will bring him into Gardens  underneath which rivers flow, therein to abide for ever. Allah hath made good  provision for him. 

[065_012]12 Allah it is who hath created seven heavens, and of the earth the like thereof.  The commandment cometh down among them slowly, that ye may know that Allah is  Able to do all things, and that Allah surroundeth all things in knowledge.

The Meaning of the Glorious Qur'an, by M.M. Pickthall, at sacred-texts.com

66. at-Tahrim: The Prohibition

[066_001]1 O Prophet! Why bannest thou that which Allah hath made lawful for thee,  seeking to please thy wives ? And Allah is Forgiving, Merciful. 

[066_002]2 Allah hath made lawful for you (Muslims) absolution from your oaths (of  such a kind), and Allah is your Protector. He is the Knower, the Wise. 

[066_003]3 When the Prophet confided a fact unto one of his wives and when she  afterward divulged it and Allah apprised him thereof, he made known (to her) part  thereof and passed over part. And when he told it her she said: Who hath told thee ?  He said: The Knower, the Aware hath told me. 

[066_004]4 If ye twain turn unto Allah repentant, (ye have cause to do so) for your hearts  desired (the ban); and if ye aid one another against him (Muhammad) then lo! Allah,  even He, is his Protecting Friend, and Gabriel and the righteous among the believers;  and furthermore the angels are his helpers. 

[066_005]5 It may happen that his Lord, if he divorce you, will give him in your stead  wives better than you, submissive (to Allah), believing, pious, penitent, devout,  inclined to fasting, widows and maids. 

[066_006]6 O ye who believe! Ward off from yourselves and your families a Fire  whereof the fuel is men and stones, over which are set angels strong, severe, who  resist not Allah in that which He commandeth them, but do that which they are  commanded. 

[066_007]7 (Then it will be said): O ye who disbelieve! Make no excuses for yourselves  this day. Ye are only being paid for what ye used to do. 

[066_008]8 O ye who believe! Turn unto Allah in sincere repentance! It may be that your  Lord will remit from you your evil deeds and bring you into Gardens underneath  which rivers flow, on the day when Allah will not abase the Prophet and those who  believe with him. Their light will run before them and on their right hands; they will  say: Our Lord!  Perfect our light for us, and forgive us! Lo! Thou art Able to do all  things. 

[066_009]9 O Prophet! Strive against the disbelievers and the hypocrites, and be stern  with them. Hell will be their home, a hapless journey's end. 

[066_010]10 Allah citeth an example for those who disbelieve: the wife of Noah and the  wife of Lot, who were under two of Our righteous slaves yet betrayed them so that  they (the husbands) availed them naught against Allah and it was said (unto them):  Enter the Fire along with those who enter. 

[066_011]11 And Allah citeth an example for those who believe: the wife of Pharaoh  when she said: My Lord! Build for me a home with thee in the Garden, and deliver  me from Pharaoh and his work, and deliver me from evil-doing folk; 

[066_012]12 And Mary, daughter of 'Imran, whose body was chaste, therefor We breathed  therein something of Our Spirit. And she put faith in the words of her Lord and His  scriptures, and was of the obedient.

The Meaning of the Glorious Qur'an, by M.M. Pickthall, at sacred-texts.com

67. al-Mulk: The Kingdom

[067_001]1 Blessed is He in Whose hand is the Sovereignty, and, He is Able to do all  things. 

[067_002]2 Who hath created life and death that He may try you which of you is best in  conduct; and He is the Mighty, the Forgiving, 

[067_003]3 Who hath created seven heavens in harmony. Thou (Muhammad) canst see  no fault in the Beneficent One's creation; then look again: Canst thou see any rifts ? 

[067_004]4 Then look again and yet again, thy sight will return unto thee weakened and  made dim. 

[067_005]5 And verily We have beautified the world's heaven with lamps, and We have  made them missiles for the devils, and for them We have prepared the doom of flame. 

[067_006]6 And for those who disbelieve in their Lord there is the doom of hell, a  hapless journey's end! 

[067_007]7 When they are flung therein they hear its roaring as it boileth up, 

[067_008]8 As it would burst with rage. Whenever a (fresh) host is flung therein the  wardens thereof ask them: Came there unto you no warner ? 

[067_009]9 They say: Yea, verily, a warner came unto us; but we denied and said: Allah  hath naught revealed; ye are in naught but a great error. 

[067_010]10 And they say: Had we been wont to listen or have sense, we had not been  among the dwellers in the flames. 

[067_011]11 So they acknowledge their sins; but far removed (from mercy) are the  dwellers in the flames. 

[067_012]12 Lo! those who fear their Lord in secret, theirs will be forgiveness and a great  reward. 

[067_013]13 And keep your opinion secret or proclaim it, lo! He is Knower of all that is in  the breasts (of men). 

[067_014]14 Should He not know what He created ? And He is the Subtile, the Aware. 

[067_015]15 He it is Who hath made the earth subservient unto you, so Walk in the paths  thereof and eat of His providence. And unto Him will be the resurrection (of the  dead). 

[067_016]16 Have ye taken security from Him Who is in the heaven that He will not cause  the earth to swallow you when lo! it is convulsed ? 

[067_017]17 Or have ye taken security from Him Who is in the heaven that He will not let  loose on you a hurricane ? But ye shall know the manner of My warning. 

[067_018]18 And verily those before them denied, then (see) the manner of My wrath  (with them)! 

[067_019]19 Have they not seen the birds above them spreading out their wings and  closing them ? Naught upholdeth them save the Beneficent. Lo! He is Seer of all  things. 

[067_020]20 Or who is he that will be an army unto you to help you instead of the  Beneficent ? The disbelievers are in naught but illusion. 

[067_021]21 Or who is he that will provide for you if He should withhold His providence  ? Nay, but they are set in pride and frowardness. 

[067_022]22 Is he who goeth groping on his face more rightly guided, or he who walketh  upright on a straight road ? 

[067_023]23 Say (unto them, O Muhammad): He it is who gave you being, and hath  assigned unto you ears and eyes and hearts. Small thanks give ye! 

[067_024]24 Say: He it is Who multiplieth you in the earth, and unto Whom ye will be  gathered. 

[067_025]25 And they say: When (will) this promise (be fulfilled), if ye are truthful ? 

[067_026]26 Say: The knowledge is with Allah only, and I am but a plain warner; 

[067_027]27 But when they see it nigh, the faces of those who disbelieve will be awry,  and it will be said (unto them): This is that for which ye used to call. 

[067_028]28 Say (O Muhammad): Have ye thought: Whether Allah causeth me  (Muhammad) and those with me to perish or hath mercy on us, still, who will protect  the disbelievers from a painful doom ? 

[067_029]29 Say: He is the Beneficent. In Him we believe and in Him we put our trust.  And ye will soon know who it is that is in error manifest. 

[067_030]30 Say: Have ye thought: If (all) your water were to disappear into the earth,  who then could bring you gushing water ?

The Meaning of the Glorious Qur'an, by M.M. Pickthall, at sacred-texts.com

68. al-Qalam: The Pen

[068_001]1 Nun. By the pen and that which they write (therewith), 

[068_002]2 Thou art not, for thy Lord's favour unto thee, a madman. 

[068_003]3 And lo! thine verily will be a reward unfailing. 

[068_004]4 And lo! thou art of a tremendous nature. 

[068_005]5 And thou wilt see and they will see 

[068_006]6 Which of you is the demented. 

[068_007]7 Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth from His way, and He is  Best Aware of those who walk aright. 

[068_008]8 Therefor obey not thou the rejecters 

[068_009]9 Who would have had thee compromise, that they may compromise. 

[068_010]10 Neither obey thou each feeble oath-monger, 

[068_011]11 Detracter, spreader abroad of slanders, 

[068_012]12 Hinderer of the good, transgressor, malefactor 

[068_013]13 Greedy therewithal, intrusive. 

[068_014]14 It is because he is possessed of wealth and children 

[068_015]15 That, when Our revelations are recited unto him, he saith: Mere fables of the  men of old. 

[068_016]16 We shall brand him on the nose. 

[068_017]17 Lo! We have tried them as We tried the owners of the garden when they  vowed that they would pluck its fruit next morning, 

[068_018]18 And made no exception (for the Will of Allah); 

[068_019]19 Then a visitation from thy Lord came upon it while they slept 

[068_020]20 And in the morning it was as if plucked. 

[068_021]21 And they cried out one unto another in the morning, 

[068_022]22 Saying: Run unto your field if ye would pluck (the fruit). 

[068_023]23 So they went off, saying one unto another in low tones: 

[068_024]24 No needy man shall enter it to-day against you. 

[068_025]25 They went betimes, strong in (this) purpose. 

[068_026]26 But when they saw it, they said: Lo! we are in error! 

[068_027]27 Nay, but we are desolate! 

[068_028]28 The best among them said: Said I not unto you: Why glorify ye not (Allah) ? 

[068_029]29 They said: Glorified be our Lord! Lo! we have been wrong-doers. 

[068_030]30 Then some of them drew near unto others, self-reproaching. 

[068_031]31 They said: Alas for us! In truth we were outrageous. 

[068_032]32 It may be that our Lord will give us better than this in place thereof. Lo! we  beseech our Lord. 

[068_033]33 Such was the punishment. And verily the punishment of the Hereafter is  greater if they did but know. 

[068_034]34 Lo! for those who keep from evil are gardens of bliss with their Lord. 

[068_035]35 Shall We then treat those who have surrendered as We treat the guilty ? 

[068_036]36 What aileth you ? How foolishly ye judge! 

[068_037]37 Or have ye a scripture wherein ye learn 

[068_038]38 That ye shall indeed have all that ye choose ? 

[068_039]39 Or have ye a covenant on oath from Us that reacheth to the Day of Judgment,  that yours shall be all that ye ordain ? 

[068_040]40 Ask them (O Muhammad) which of them will vouch for that! 

[068_041]41 Or have they other gods ? Then let them bring their other gods if they are  truthful 

[068_042]42 On the day when it befalleth in earnest, and they are ordered to prostrate  themselves but are not able, 

[068_043]43 With eyes downcast, abasement stupefying them. And they had been  summoned to prostrate themselves while they were yet unhurt. 

[068_044]44 Leave Me (to deal) with those who give the lie to this pronouncement. We  shall lead them on by steps from whence they know not. 

[068_045]45 Yet I bear with them, for lo! My scheme is firm. 

[068_046]46 Or dost thou (Muhammad) ask a fee from them so that they are heavily taxed  ? 

[068_047]47 Or is the Unseen theirs that they can write (thereof) ? 

[068_048]48 But wait thou for thy Lord's decree, and be not like him of the fish, who cried  out in despair. 

[068_049]49 Had it not been that favour from his Lord had reached him he surely had  been cast into the wilderness while he was reprobate. 

[068_050]50 But his Lord chose him and placed him among the righteous. 

[068_051]51 And lo! those who disbelieve would fain disconcert thee with their eyes  when they hear the Reminder, and they say: Lo! he is indeed mad; 

[068_052]52 When it is naught else than a Reminder to creation.

69. al-Haqqah: The Inevitable

[069_001]1 The Reality! 

[069_002]2 What is the Reality ? 

[069_003]3 Ah, what will convey unto thee what the reality is! 

[069_004]4 (The tribes of) Thamud and A'ad disbelieved in the judgment to come. 

[069_005]5 As for Thamud, they were destroyed by the lightning. 

[069_006]6 And as for A'ad, they were destroyed by a fierce roaring wind, 

[069_007]7 Which He imposed on them for seven long nights and eight long days so that  thou mightest have seen men lying overthrown, as they were hollow trunks of palm- trees. 

[069_008]8 Canst thou (O Muhammad) see any remnant of them ? 

[069_009]9 And Pharaoh and those before him, and the communities that were  destroyed, brought error, 

[069_010]10 And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, therefor did He grip them  with a tightening grip. 

[069_011]11 Lo! when the waters rose, We carried you upon the ship 

[069_012]12 That We might make it a memorial for you, and that remembering ears (that  heard the story) might remember. 

[069_013]13 And when the trumpet shall sound one blast 

[069_014]14 And the earth with the mountains shall be lifted up and crushed with one  crash, 

[069_015]15 Then, on that day will the Event befall. 

[069_016]16 And the heaven will split asunder, for that day it will be frail. 

[069_017]17 And the angels will be on the sides thereof, and eight will uphold the Throne  of thy Lord that day, above them. 

[069_018]18 On that day ye will be exposed; not a secret of you will be hidden. 

[069_019]19 Then, as for him who is given his record in his right hand, he will say: Take,  read my book! 

[069_020]20 Surely I knew that I should have to meet my reckoning. 

[069_021]21 Then he will be in blissful state 

[069_022]22 In a high garden 

[069_023]23 Whereof the clusters are in easy reach. 

[069_024]24 (And it will be said unto those therein): Eat and drink at ease for that which  ye sent on before you in past days. 

[069_025]25 But as for him who is given his record in his left hand, he will say: Oh,  would that I had not been given my book 

[069_026]26 And knew not what my reckoning! 

[069_027]27 Oh, would that it had been death! 

[069_028]28 My wealth hath not availed me, 

[069_029]29 My power hath gone from me. 

[069_030]30 (It will be said): Take him and fetter him 

[069_031]31 And then expose him to hell-fire 

[069_032]32 And then insert him in a chain whereof the length is seventy cubits. 

[069_033]33 Lo! He used not to believe in Allah the Tremendous, 

[069_034]34 And urged not on the feeding of the wretched. 

[069_035]35 Therefor hath he no lover here this day, 

[069_036]36 Nor any food save filth 

[069_037]37 Which none but sinners eat. 

[069_038]38 But nay! I swear by all that ye see 

[069_039]39 And all that ye see not 

[069_040]40 That it is indeed the speech of an illustrious messenger. 

[069_041]41 It is not poet's speech - little is it that ye believe! 

[069_042]42 Nor diviner's speech - little is it that ye remember! 

[069_043]43 It is a revelation from the Lord of the Worlds. 

[069_044]44 And if he had invented false sayings concerning Us, 

[069_045]45 We assuredly had taken him by the right hand 

[069_046]46 And then severed his life-artery, 

[069_047]47 And not one of you could have held Us off from him. 

[069_048]48 And lo! it is a warrant unto those who ward off (evil). 

[069_049]49 And lo! We know that some among you will deny (it). 

[069_050]50 And lo! it is indeed an anguish for the disbelievers. 

[069_051]51 And lo! it is absolute truth. 

[069_052]52 So glorify the name of thy Tremendous Lord.

70. al-Ma`arij: The Ladders

[070_001]1 A questioner questioned concerning the doom about to fall 

[070_002]2 Upon the disbelievers, which none can repel, 

[070_003]3 From Allah, Lord of the Ascending Stairways 

[070_004]4 (Whereby) the angels and the Spirit ascend unto Him in a Day whereof the  span is fifty thousand years. 

[070_005]5 But be patient (O Muhammad) with a patience fair to see. 

[070_006]6 Lo! they behold it afar off 

[070_007]7 While we behold it nigh: 

[070_008]8 The day when the sky will become as molten copper, 

[070_009]9 And the hills become as flakes of wool, 

[070_010]10 And no familiar friend will ask a question of his friend 

[070_011]11 Though they will be given sight of them. The guilty man will long to be able  to ransom himself from the punishment of that day at the price of his children 

[070_012]12 And his spouse and his brother 

[070_013]13 And his kin that harboured him 

[070_014]14 And all that are in the earth, if then it might deliver him. 

[070_015]15 But nay! for lo! it is the fire of hell 

[070_016]16 Eager to roast; 

[070_017]17 It calleth him who turned and fled (from truth), 

[070_018]18 And hoarded (wealth) and withheld it. 

[070_019]19 Lo! man was created anxious, 

[070_020]20 Fretful when evil befalleth him 

[070_021]21 And, when good befalleth him, grudging; 

[070_022]22 Save worshippers. 

[070_023]23 Who are constant at their worship 

[070_024]24 And in whose wealth there is a right acknowledged 

[070_025]25 For the beggar and the destitute; 

[070_026]26 And those who believe in the Day of Judgment, 

[070_027]27 And those who are fearful of their Lord's doom - 

[070_028]28 Lo! the doom of their Lord is that before which none can feel secure - 

[070_029]29 And those who preserve their chastity 

[070_030]30 Save with their wives and those whom their right hands possess, for thus  they are not blameworthy; 

[070_031]31 But whoso seeketh more than that, those are they who are transgressors; 

[070_032]32 And those who keep their pledges and their covenant, 

[070_033]33 And those who stand by their testimony 

[070_034]34 And those who are attentive at their worship. 

[070_035]35 These will dwell in Gardens, honoured. 

[070_036]36 What aileth those who disbelieve, that they keep staring toward thee (O  Muhammad), open-eyed, 

[070_037]37 On the right and on the left, in groups ? 

[070_038]38 Doth every man among them hope to enter the Garden of Delight ? 

[070_039]39 Nay, verily. Lo! We created them from what they know. 

[070_040]40 But nay! I swear by the Lord of the rising-places and the setting-places of the  planets that We verily are Able 

[070_041]41 To replace them by (others) better than them. And we are not to be outrun. 

[070_042]42 So let them chat and play until they meet their Day which they are promised, 

[070_043]43 The day when they come forth from the graves in haste, as racing to a goal, 

[070_044]44 With eyes aghast, abasement stupefying them: Such is the Day which they  are promised.

71. Nuh: Noah

[071_001]1 Lo! We sent Noah unto his people (saying): Warn thy people ere the painful  doom come unto them. 

[071_002]2 He said: O my people! Lo! I am a plain warner unto you 

[071_003]3 (Bidding you): Serve Allah and keep your duty unto Him and obey me, 

[071_004]4 That He may forgive you somewhat of your sins and respite you to an  appointed term. Lo! the term of Allah, when it cometh, cannot be delayed, if ye but  knew. 

[071_005]5 He said: My Lord! Lo! I have called unto my people night and day 

[071_006]6 But all my calling doth but add to their repugnance; 

[071_007]7 And lo! whenever I call unto them that Thou mayst pardon them they thrust  their fingers in their ears and cover themselves with their garments and persist (in  their refusal) and magnify themselves in pride. 

[071_008]8 And lo! I have called unto them aloud, 

[071_009]9 And lo! I have made public proclamation unto them, and I have appealed to  them in private. 

[071_010]10 And I have said: Seek pardon of your Lord. Lo! He was ever Forgiving. 

[071_011]11 He will let loose the sky for you in plenteous rain, 

[071_012]12 And will help you with wealth and sons, and will assign unto you Gardens  and will assign unto you rivers. 

[071_013]13 What aileth you that ye hope not toward Allah for dignity 

[071_014]14 When He created you by (divers) stages ? 

[071_015]15 See ye not how Allah hath created seven heavens in harmony, 

[071_016]16 And hath made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp ? 

[071_017]17 And Allah hath caused you to grow as a growth from the earth, 

[071_018]18 And afterward He maketh you return thereto, and He will bring you forth  again, a (new) forthbringing. 

[071_019]19 And Allah hath made the earth a wide expanse for you 

[071_020]20 That ye may thread the valley-ways thereof. 

[071_021]21 Noah said: My Lord! Lo! they have disobeyed me and followed one whose  wealth and children increase him in naught save ruin; 

[071_022]22 And they have plotted a mighty plot, 

[071_023]23 And they have said: Forsake not your gods. Forsake not Wadd, nor Suwa',  nor Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr. 

[071_024]24 And they have led many astray, and Thou increasest the wrong-doers in  naught save error. 

[071_025]25 Because of their sins they were drowned, then made to enter a Fire. And they  found they had no helpers in place of Allah. 

[071_026]26 And Noah said: My Lord! Leave not one of the disbelievers in the land. 

[071_027]27 If Thou shouldst leave them, they will mislead Thy slaves and will beget  none save lewd ingrates. 

[071_028]28 My Lord! Forgive me and my parents and him who entereth my house  believing, and believing men and believing women, and increase not the wrong-doers  in aught save ruin.

72. al-Jinn: The Jinn

[072_001]1 Say (O Muhammad): It is revealed unto me that a company of the Jinn gave  ear, and they said: Lo! we have heard a marvellous Qur'an, 

[072_002]2 Which guideth unto righteousness, so we believe in it and we ascribe no  partner unto our Lord. 

[072_003]3 And (we believe) that He - exalted be the glory of our Lord! - hath taken  neither wife nor son, 

[072_004]4 And that the foolish one among us used to speak concerning Allah an  atrocious lie. 

[072_005]5 And lo! we had supposed that humankind and jinn would not speak a lie  concerning Allah - 

[072_006]6 And indeed (O Muhammad) individuals of humankind used to invoke the  protection of individuals of the jinn, so that they increased them in revolt against  Allah); 

[072_007]7 And indeed they supposed, even as ye suppose, that Allah would not raise  anyone (from the dead) - 

[072_008]8 And (the Jinn who had listened to the Qur'an said): We had sought the  heaven but had found it filled with strong warders and meteors. 

[072_009]9 And we used to sit on places (high) therein to listen. But he who listeneth  now findeth a flame in wait for him; 

[072_010]10 And we know not whether harm is boded unto all who are in the earth, or  whether their Lord intendeth guidance for them. 

[072_011]11 And among us there are righteous folk and among us there are far from that.  We are sects having different rules. 

[072_012]12 And we know that we cannot escape from Allah in the earth, nor can we  escape by flight. 

[072_013]13 And when we heard the guidance, we believed therein, and whoso believeth  in his Lord, he feareth neither loss nor oppression. 

[072_014]14 And there are among us some who have surrendered (to Allah) and there are  among us some who are unjust. And whoso hath surrendered to Allah, such have  taken the right path purposefully. 

[072_015]15 And as for those who are unjust, they are firewood for hell. 

[072_016]16 If they (the idolaters) tread the right path, We shall give them to drink of  water in abundance 

[072_017]17 That We may test them thereby, and whoso turneth away from the  remembrance of his Lord; He will thrust him into ever-growing torment. 

[072_018]18 And the places of worship are only for Allah, so pray not unto anyone along  with Allah. 

[072_019]19 And when the slave of Allah stood up in prayer to Him, they crowded on  him, almost stifling. 

[072_020]20 Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I pray unto Allah only, and ascribe unto  Him no partner. 

[072_021]21 Say: Lo! I control not hurt nor benefit for you. 

[072_022]22 Say: Lo! none can protect me from Allah, nor can I find any refuge beside  Him 

[072_023]23 (Mine is) but conveyance (of the Truth) from Allah, and His messages; and  whoso disobeyeth Allah and His messenger, lo! his is fire of hell, wherein such dwell  for ever. 

[072_024]24 Till (the day) when they shall behold that which they are promised (they may  doubt); but then they will know (for certain) who is weaker in allies and less in  multitude. 

[072_025]25 Say (O Muhammad, unto the disbelievers): I know not whether that which ye  are promised is nigh, or if my Lord hath set a distant term for it. 

[072_026]26 (He is) the Knower of the Unseen, and He revealeth unto none His secret, 

[072_027]27 Save unto every messenger whom He hath chosen, and then He maketh a  guard to go before him and a guard behind him 

[072_028]28 That He may know that they have indeed conveyed the messages of their  Lord. He surroundeth all their doings, and He keepeth count of all things.

The Meaning of the Glorious Qur'an, by M.M. Pickthall, at sacred-texts.com

73. al-Muzammil: The Mantled One

[073_001]1 O thou wrapped up in thy raiment! 

[073_002]2 Keep vigil the night long, save a little - 

[073_003]3 A half thereof, or abate a little thereof 

[073_004]4 Or add (a little) thereto - and chant the Qur'an in measure, 

[073_005]5 For we shall charge thee with a word of weight. 

[073_006]6 Lo! the vigil of the night is (a time) when impression is more keen and  speech more certain. 

[073_007]7 Lo! thou hast by day a chain of business. 

[073_008]8 So remember the name of thy Lord and devote thyself with a complete  devotion - 

[073_009]9 Lord of the East and the West; there is no God save Him; so choose thou  Him alone for thy defender - 

[073_010]10 And bear with patience what they utter, and part from them with a fair leave- taking. 

[073_011]11 Leave Me to deal with the deniers, lords of ease and comfort (in this life);  and do thou respite them awhile. 

[073_012]12 Lo! with Us are heavy fetters and a raging fire, 

[073_013]13 And food which choketh (the partaker), and a painful doom 

[073_014]14 On the day when the earth and the hills rock, and the hills become a heap of  running sand. 

[073_015]15 Lo! We have sent unto you a messenger as witness against you, even as We  sent unto Pharaoh a messenger. 

[073_016]16 But Pharaoh rebelled against the messenger, whereupon We seized him with  no gentle grip. 

[073_017]17 Then how, if ye disbelieve, will ye protect yourselves upon the day which  will turn children grey, 

[073_018]18 The very heaven being then rent asunder. His promise is to be fulfilled. 

[073_019]19 Lo! This is a Reminder. Let him who will, then, choose a way unto his Lord. 

[073_020]20 Lo! thy Lord knoweth how thou keepest vigil sometimes nearly two-thirds of  the night, or (sometimes) half or a third thereof, as do a party of those with thee.  Allah measureth the night and the day. He knoweth that ye count it not, and turneth  unto you in mercy. Recite, then, of the Qur'an that which is easy for you. He knoweth  that there are sick folk among you, while others travel in the land in search of Allah's  bounty, and others (still) are fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite of it that which  is easy (for you), and establish worship and pay the poor-due, and (so) lend unto  Allah a goodly loan. Whatsoever good ye send before you for your souls, ye will find  it with Allah, better and greater in the recompense. And seek forgiveness of Allah.  Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

The Meaning of the Glorious Qur'an, by M.M. Pickthall, at sacred-texts.com

74. al-Mudathir: The Clothed One

[074_001]1 O thou enveloped in thy cloak, 

[074_002]2 Arise and warn! 

[074_003]3 Thy Lord magnify, 

[074_004]4 Thy raiment purify, 

[074_005]5 Pollution shun! 

[074_006]6 And show not favour, seeking wordly gain! 

[074_007]7 For the sake of thy Lord, be patient! 

[074_008]8 For when the trumpet shall sound, 

[074_009]9 Surely that day will be a day of anguish, 

[074_010]10 Not of ease, for disbelievers. 

[074_011]11 Leave Me (to deal) with him whom I created lonely, 

[074_012]12 And then bestowed upon him ample means, 

[074_013]13 And sons abiding in his presence 

[074_014]14 And made (life) smooth for him. 

[074_015]15 Yet he desireth that I should give more. 

[074_016]16 Nay! For lo! he hath been stubborn to Our revelations. 

[074_017]17 On him I shall impose a fearful doom. 

[074_018]18 For lo! he did consider; then he planned - 

[074_019]19 (Self-)destroyed is he, how he planned! 

[074_020]20 Again (self-)destroyed is he, how he planned! - 

[074_021]21 Then looked he, 

[074_022]22 Then frowned he and showed displeasure. 

[074_023]23 Then turned he away in pride 

[074_024]24 And said: This is naught else than magic from of old; 

[074_025]25 This is naught else than speech of mortal man. 

[074_026]26 Him shall I fling unto the burning. 

[074_027]27  - Ah, what will convey unto thee what that burning is! - 

[074_028]28 It leaveth naught; it spareth naught 

[074_029]29 It shrivelleth the man. 

[074_030]30 Above it are nineteen. 

[074_031]31 We have appointed only angels to be wardens of the Fire, and their number  have We made to be a stumbling-block for those who disbelieve; that those to whom  the Scripture hath been given may have certainty, and that believers may increase in  faith; and that those to whom the Scripture hath been given and believers may not  doubt; and that those in whose hearts there is disease, and disbelievers, may say:  What meaneth Allah by this similitude ? Thus Allah sendeth astray whom He will,  and whom He will He guideth. None knoweth the hosts of thy Lord save Him. This is  naught else than a Reminder unto mortals. 

[074_032]32 Nay, by the Moon 

[074_033]33 And the night when it withdraweth 

[074_034]34 And the dawn when it shineth forth, 

[074_035]35 Lo! this is one of the greatest (portents) 

[074_036]36 As a warning unto men, 

[074_037]37 Unto him of you who will advance or hang back. 

[074_038]38 Every soul is a pledge for its own deeds; 

[074_039]39 Save those who will stand on the right hand. 

[074_040]40 In gardens they will ask one another 

[074_041]41 Concerning the guilty: 

[074_042]42 What hath brought you to this burning ? 

[074_043]43 They will answer: We were not of those who prayed 

[074_044]44 Nor did we feed the wretched. 

[074_045]45 We used to wade (in vain dispute) with (all) waders, 

[074_046]46 And we used to deny the Day of Judgment, 

[074_047]47 Till the Inevitable came unto us. 

[074_048]48 The mediation of no mediators will avail them then. 

[074_049]49 Why now turn they away from the Admonishment, 

[074_050]50 As they were frightened asses 

[074_051]51 Fleeing from a lion ? 

[074_052]52 Nay, but everyone of them desireth that he should be given open pages (from  Allah). 

[074_053]53 Nay, verily. They fear not the Hereafter. 

[074_054]54 Nay, verily. Lo! this is an Admonishment. 

[074_055]55 So whosoever will may heed. 

[074_056]56 And they will not heed unless Allah willeth (it). He is the fount of fear. He is  the fount of Mercy.

75. al-Qiyamah: The Resurrection

[075_001]1 Nay, I swear by the Day of Resurrection; 

[075_002]2 Nay, I swear by the accusing soul (that this Scripture is true). 

[075_003]3 Thinketh man that We shall not assemble his bones ? 

[075_004]4 Yea, verily. We are Able to restore his very fingers! 

[075_005]5 But man would fain deny what is before him. 

[075_006]6 He asketh: When will be this Day of Resurrection ? 

[075_007]7 But when sight is confounded 

[075_008]8 And the moon is eclipsed 

[075_009]9 And sun and moon are united, 

[075_010]10 On that day man will cry: Whither to flee! 

[075_011]11 Alas! No refuge! 

[075_012]12 Unto thy Lord is the recourse that day. 

[075_013]13 On that day man is told the tale of that which he hath sent before and left  behind. 

[075_014]14 Oh, but man is a telling witness against himself, 

[075_015]15 Although he tender his excuses. 

[075_016]16 Stir not thy tongue herewith to hasten it. 

[075_017]17 Lo! upon Us (resteth) the putting together thereof and the reading thereof. 

[075_018]18 And when We read it, follow thou the reading; 

[075_019]19 Then lo! upon Us (resteth) the explanation thereof. 

[075_020]20 Nay, but ye do love the fleeting Now 

[075_021]21 And neglect the Hereafter. 

[075_022]22 That day will faces be resplendent, 

[075_023]23 Looking toward their Lord; 

[075_024]24 And that day will other faces be despondent, 

[075_025]25 Thou wilt know that some great disaster is about to fall on them. 

[075_026]26 Nay, but when the life cometh up to the throat 

[075_027]27 And men say: Where is the wizard (who can save him now) ? 

[075_028]28 And he knoweth that it is the parting; 

[075_029]29 And agony is heaped on agony; 

[075_030]30 Unto thy Lord that day will be the driving. 

[075_031]31 For he neither trusted, nor prayed. 

[075_032]32 But he denied and flouted. 

[075_033]33 Then went he to his folk with glee. 

[075_034]34 Nearer unto thee and nearer, 

[075_035]35 Again nearer unto thee and nearer (is the doom). 

[075_036]36 Thinketh man that he is to be left aimless ? 

[075_037]37 Was he not a drop of fluid which gushed forth ? 

[075_038]38 Then he became a clot; then (Allah) shaped and fashioned 

[075_039]39 And made of him a pair, the male and female. 

[075_040]40 Is not He (Who doeth so) Able to bring the dead to life ?

76. ad-Dahr: The Man

[076_001]1 Hath there come upon man (ever) any period of time in which he was a thing  unremembered ? 

[076_002]2 Lo! We create man from a drop of thickened fluid to test him; so We make  him hearing, knowing. 

[076_003]3 Lo! We have shown him the way, whether he be grateful or disbelieving. 

[076_004]4 Lo! We have prepared for disbelievers manacles and carcans and a raging  fire. 

[076_005]5 Lo! the righteous shall drink of a cup whereof the mixture is of Kafur, 

[076_006]6 A spring wherefrom the slaves of Allah drink, making it gush forth  abundantly, 

[076_007]7 (Because) they perform the vow and fear a day whereof the evil is wide- spreading, 

[076_008]8 And feed with food the needy wretch, the orphan and the prisoner, for love  of Him, 

[076_009]9 (Saying): We feed you, for the sake of Allah only. We wish for no reward  nor thanks from you; 

[076_010]10 Lo! we fear from our Lord a day of frowning and of fate. 

[076_011]11 Therefor Allah hath warded off from them the evil of that day, and hath  made them find brightness and joy; 

[076_012]12 And hath awarded them for all that they endured, a Garden and silk attire; 

[076_013]13 Reclining therein upon couches, they will find there neither (heat of) a sun  nor bitter cold. 

[076_014]14 The shade thereof is close upon them and the clustered fruits thereof bow  down. 

[076_015]15 Goblets of silver are brought round for them, and beakers (as) of glass 

[076_016]16 (Bright as) glass but (made) of silver, which they (themselves) have  measured to the measure (of their deeds). 

[076_017]17 There are they watered with a cup whereof the mixture is of Zanjabil, 

[076_018]18 (The water of) a spring therein, named Salsabil. 

[076_019]19 There wait on them immortal youths, whom, when thou seest, thou wouldst  take for scattered pearls. 

[076_020]20 When thou seest, thou wilt see there bliss and high estate. 

[076_021]21 Their raiment will be fine green silk and gold embroidery. Bracelets of silver  will they wear. Their Lord will slake their thirst with a pure drink. 

[076_022]22 (And it will be said unto them): Lo! this is a reward for you. Your endeavour  (upon earth) hath found acceptance. 

[076_023]23 Lo! We, even We, have revealed unto thee the Qur'an, a revelation; 

[076_024]24 So submit patiently to thy Lord's command, and obey not of them any guilty  one or disbeliever. 

[076_025]25 Remember the name of thy Lord at morn and evening. 

[076_026]26 And worship Him (a portion) of the night. And glorify Him through the  livelong night. 

[076_027]27 Lo! these love fleeting life, and put behind them (the remembrance of) a  grievous day. 

[076_028]28 We, even We, created them, and strengthened their frame. And when We  will, We can replace them, bringing others like them in their stead. 

[076_029]29 Lo! this is an Admonishment, that whosoever will may choose a way unto  his Lord. 

[076_030]30 Yet ye will not, unless Allah willeth. Lo! Allah is Knower, Wise. 

[076_031]31 He maketh whom He will to enter His mercy, and for evil-doers hath  prepared a painful doom.

[077_001]1 By the emissary winds, (sent) one after another

[077_003]3 By those which cause earth's vegetation to revive;

[077_020]20 Did We not create you from a base fluid 

[077_021]21 Which We laid up in a safe abode 

[077_022]22 For a known term ? 

[077_023]23 Thus We arranged. How excellent is Our arranging!

[077_025]25 Have We not made the earth a receptacle

[077_027]27 And placed therein high mountains and given you to drink sweet water  therein ?

[077_031]31 (Which yet is) no relief nor shelter from the flame. 

[077_032]32 Lo! it throweth up sparks like the castles, 

[077_033]33 (Or) as it might be camels of bright yellow hue. 

[077_034]34 Woe unto the repudiators on that day! 

[077_035]35 This is a day wherein they speak not, 

[077_036]36 Nor are they suffered to put forth excuses. 

[077_037]37 Woe unto the repudiators on that day! 

[077_038]38 This is the Day of Decision, We have brought you and the men of old  together. 

[077_039]39 If now ye have any wit, outwit Me. 

[077_040]40 Woe unto the repudiators on that day! 

[077_041]41 Lo! those who kept their duty are amid shade and fountains, 

[077_042]42 And fruits such as they desire. 

[077_043]43 (Unto them it is said:) Eat, drink and welcome, O ye blessed, in return for  what ye did. 

[077_044]44 Thus do We reward the good. 

[077_045]45 Woe unto the repudiators on that day! 

[077_046]46 Eat and take your ease (on earth) a little. Lo! ye are guilty. 

[077_047]47 Woe unto the repudiators on that day! 

[077_048]48 When it is said unto them: Bow down, they bow not down! 

[077_049]49 Woe unto the repudiators on that day! 

[077_050]50 In what statement, after this, will they believe ?

[080_004]4 Or take heed and so the reminder might avail him ? 

[080_005]5 As for him who thinketh himself independent,

[080_013]13 On honoured leaves 

[080_014]14 Exalted, purified,
